description_zh: 调用 UpdateLocalitySetting 接口更新本地化配置
kebab_example: aliyun edas update-locality-setting --biz-region cn-hangzhou --namespace-id cn-hangzhou --app-id bfa00cfb-9642-4292-bb78-1d7d4c86004c --enabled false --threshold 15.0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLocalitySetting

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the elastic compute unit (ECU) is located
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: The ID of the namespace. This ID cannot be changed after the namespace is created. The format is \[unk]physical space identifier\[unk]
parameters.help_zh: 命名空间id>创建后不可变，格式为[unk]物理空间标识符[unk]
parameters.name: namespace_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149390.html operation to obtain this ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the setting is active:

- true: The setting is active.

- false: The setting is not active
parameters.help_zh:
设置是否已生效：
 
- true：已生效。
- false：未生效
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en: The total number of items that satisfy the threshold expression
parameters.help_zh: 满足阈值表达式的总个数
parameters.name: threshold
